ahunavaiti-gatha.title: Ahunavaitī Gāthā (Yasna 28–34)
ahunavaiti-gatha.description: The first Gāthā collection, Yasna 28–34 — the oldest stratum of the Avesta, hymns in the ancient dialect attributed to Zarathustra himself.

ustavaiti-gatha.title: Uštavaitī Gāthā (Yasna 43–46)
ustavaiti-gatha.description: The second Gāthā collection, Yasna 43–46 — 'hymns of bliss', continuing the oldest Avestan stratum attributed to Zarathustra.

spenta-mainyu-gatha.title: Spentā-Mainyū Gāthā (Yasna 47–50)
spenta-mainyu-gatha.description: The third Gāthā collection, Yasna 47–50, named for the Bounteous Spirit invoked in its opening.

vohu-khsathra-gatha.title: Vohu-Khšathrā Gāthā (Yasna 51)
vohu-khsathra-gatha.description: The fourth Gāthā collection, the single long hymn of Yasna 51, named for the Good Dominion.

vahistoisti-gatha.title: Vahištōišti Gāthā (Yasna 53)
vahistoisti-gatha.description: The fifth and last Gāthā, Yasna 53 — traditionally associated with the marriage of Zarathustra's daughter.

the-yasna.title: The Yasna · 72 chapters (hā)
the-yasna.description: The chief liturgical text of the Avesta — seventy-two chapters (hā) recited in the central act of worship, enclosing the Gāthās at its heart.

the-yasna-hapta-haiti.title: The Yasna Haptaŋhāiti (Yasna 35–41)
the-yasna-hapta-haiti.description: The 'Worship of the Seven Chapters', Yasna 35–41 — old Avestan prose nearly as ancient as the Gāthās themselves.

the-visperad.title: The Visperad · ~24 sections
the-visperad.description: A collection of supplements to the Yasna — invocations of 'all the lords' (vīspe ratavo) — recited with it at seasonal festivals.
